title: startsClaude and the test-run guard don't read Windows shell bodies (cmd /c, powershell -Command)
notes: startsClaude (src/main/actions/pane/send.ts) and testRunFolders (src/main/workflow/test-run-guard.ts) unwrap only sh -c bodies. Typing `cmd /c claude` into a Windows pane's shell starts a worker with none of the app's settings, which startsClaude exists to refuse. Once windowsShellBody from #364 moves to hook-answer.ts, use it in both. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/365 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/364#discussion_r4685923306

comments.body: Already done by 4e0208d0 (shellBody reads Windows shell bodies).
